create.name: Marysol Ximenez-Carrillo
create.bio:
Marysol Ximenez-Carrillo is a singer and sound healer based in Hildesheim, Germany, whose main instrument is her own voice. She studied singing, dance and acting at the University of the Arts in Berlin and worked in theatre and music productions for over twenty years before moving into energy work. Long study followed in energy and quantum healing, mediumship and shamanic practice, then a month in Peru in 2019 and later courses with the Peruvian teacher don Oscar Miro-Quesada, through whom she became a carrier of the Pachakuti Mesa tradition. For several years she has helped lead a weekly European online ceremony for his Heart of the Healer school.

All of her sessions and group events happen over Zoom. She sings intuitively in what she calls light language, wordless sound she receives as guidance, and weaves it with guided inner journeys, shamanic elements and spiritual coaching. Besides one-to-one sessions she records personal sound pieces for individual listeners, runs short live online series, and shares free guided meditations, channelled transmissions and music on YouTube, SoundCloud and Insight Timer, in English and in German.

courses.title: 1:1 Sound & Energy Healing Session
courses.description: A private Zoom session of up to ninety minutes that opens with a conversation about what you would like, then moves into energy work with live, intuitive singing and an inner journey. Headphones are recommended for the sound.

courses.title: Personal Sound Healing Recording
courses.description: Marysol tunes in to you from a recent photo and sings an intuitive light-language piece over licensed music, then sends it as an MP3 to keep. Allow four to six weeks for delivery.

courses.title: Soul Alignment
courses.description: Two live Zoom evenings of up to two and a half hours each, on 6 and 13 December, with sung sound transmissions, guided visualisation, energy work, channelled messages and time for questions. Recordings of both sessions are yours to keep.
courses.price: 144 EUR early bird (until 20 November), then 188 EUR

free_resources.title: Marysol Ximenez-Carrillo on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations and sound journeys sung in light language, plus music for relaxation and reflection, free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Music and Guided Meditations
free_resources.description: A page of free playlists on her own site: sound pieces, songs and guided meditations in both English and German, with a lighter set of spiritual comedy songs as well.

flags: Her About page tells her own story of teenage depression and how she later left it behind through energy work (personal background, not a sales claim); no condition is named on any page selling her sessions, but a human may want to read it under the strict health rule.
Email comes from the site's legal notice (Impressum), not a contact page; it is her own domain.
Based in Hildesheim but all sessions and events are online (Zoom) with no in-person base, so availability is worldwide with no city.
Second photo (sunlit close-up from her About page) looks like the same woman as the studio headshot, which is also her Insight Timer photo, but the light makes it a little less certain.
left_out: Calming your Mind – Activating your Higher Mind (online event, 7 Nov 2026): the event page asks about thought patterns that bring up anxiety; borderline, so left out.
The Portal of your Sacred Heart (444 EUR on-demand course): one session features a guest billed as a 'Medical Medium'; left out under the 'anything medical' rule.
Recordings of past events: a shop category, not one offering with its own page.
YouTube 'Sound Healing for STRESS RELIEF & RELAXATION & INSOMNIA' and 'Sleep and Relaxation Meditation ... Fall Asleep Easily': named for a condition or sleep problem.
YouTube 'Guided Meditation with the Elements' (bx4bGJXl-Eg): oEmbed returned 401.
Music-only tracks and song covers (Keith Holding collaborations, Spiritual Comedy) left out of videos.
Facebook page and Telegram channel are linked from her site but were not counted or listed (Facebook not readable without login).
